newsitem.title: LEBANON: Lebanon Hizbollah bomb kills two Israeli soldiers.
newsitem.headline: Lebanon Hizbollah bomb kills two Israeli soldiers.

text.p: Two Israeli soldiers were killed and four wounded in south Lebanon when pro-Iranian Hizbollah guerrillas set off a bomb near their patrol overnight, pro-Israeli militia sources said on Friday.

The blast targeted the foot patrol in the Jarmaq-Aishiyyeh area in the central sector of Israel's 15-km (nine-mile) deep south Lebanon occupation zone at about midnight, the sources with the South Lebanon Army (SLA) militia said.
In Beirut, Hizbollah claimed responsibility for the attack.

An Israeli army spokeswoman said in Jerusalem: "A bomb was set off against an Israeli force on patrol in the eastern sector of the south Lebanon security zone. Two soldiers were killed and four were wounded, three severely. Hizbollah took responsibility for the incident."
Hizbollah (Party of God) leads a guerrilla war against some 1,000 Israeli soldiers in the zone and the 3,000-strong SLA in a bid to oust them from south Lebanon.

Israeli security forces have been on high alert this week fearing guerrilla attacks around the first anniversary of the assassination of Islamic Jihad leader Fathi Shqaqi, which members of the group say Israeli secret agents carried out.
